title: Custom OMA-URI settings that now have Settings Catalog equivalents

report.title: {Items.Count} custom {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile contains', 'profiles contain')} settings now available in the Settings Catalog

messages.businessImpact: Custom OMA-URI has no validation, no reporting per setting and no protection against a typo, so it is the hardest configuration to support and the easiest to get quietly wrong.
remediation: Replace the settings that now exist in the Settings Catalog and keep custom URIs only for what is genuinely unavailable.
